units.source_text: 然而，所有一切都让人兴致勃勃。

en.t: Still, everything about it was exciting.

units.source_text: 女人的举动使他情绪很放松，他甚至对自己说，这一夜可真是难得的经历呀。

en.t: The woman's behavior put him at ease, and he even told himself that this night was a rare experience indeed.

units.source_text: 弄得不好，还能撞上什么有趣的虫子呢。

en.t: If things went a certain way, he might even come across some interesting insect.

units.source_text: 说什么这里也像是昆虫乐于居住的环境。

en.t: After all, this also seemed like the sort of environment insects would enjoy living in.
